battle.name: 宋子賢起義
battle.brief: 大業九年(613)秋，隋煬帝自遼東班師，車駕駐高陽(十月改博陵為高陽郡)。唐縣人宋子賢以幻術每夜放光變佛形，自稱彌勒出世，聚數千百人，擬乘夜襲乘輿。事洩，官軍夜至，以「此地素無坑，止妖妄耳」破其幻術，擒斬宋子賢，連坐一千多家。羅馬重步兵未見於此役，現場是刀矛弓弩與燈鏡帷幕。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 大業九年(613)年的河北平原上，站着兩個對立的力量。朝廷一方是隋煬帝楊廣的中央政府：皇帝自遼東戰事班師，沿涿郡、河間、博陵一線南還，車駕所至，宿衛武賁、殿前宿衛與沿途州郡的郡兵、縣兵構成縱深；河北道各州置刺史，郡置太守、縣置令，州郡兵與屯田農兵的調發是地方唯一能迅速集結的武裝，這套體系的指揮鏈是一條從洛陽到州郡的文書線，命令層級多、臨時編組多、彼此不熟。起事一方是唐縣人宋子賢為首的民間結社，靠幻術與「彌勒佛出世」的說辭聚起數千百人，人數不多，沒有攻城器械，沒有遠射器材，唯一可以倚仗的，是在夜色裡製造的視覺錯覺與對行營的突然接近。第三方是北面草原的突厥與東北的高句麗：兩線用兵吸走隋廷的精騎與物資，使河北腹地在613年秋天既缺援軍，也缺能迅速壓制的重兵。整個局面可以概括為一句話：中央靠制度與文書控制地方，民間靠夜間的奇襲製造破口，而真正決定結局的，是郡兵與縣吏能不能在黑夜里把事情按下去。
countriesEn: On the Hebei plain in the ninth year of Daye (613) two opposed forces stood face to face. On the court side was the central government of Sui Yangdi: the emperor, returning from the war in Liaodong, was moving south along the line of Zhuojun, Hejian and Boling, and the forces at his disposal were the Wuwen guards of the imperial retinue, the palace guard quarters, and the commandery and county troops mustered along the route. Hebei Circuit had a prefect in each prefecture, a commandant in each commandery and a magistrate in each county, and the mustering of commandery troops and of garrisoned peasants was the only armed force the localities could raise quickly. The command system that stood behind it was a documentary chain running from Luoyang down to the prefectures and counties: many links, many ad hoc formations, and very little familiarity between the men in them. On the other side stood the private association headed by Song Zixian of Tang County, held together by sleight of hand and by the claim that Maitreya had come into the world. It numbered no more than a thousand or a few thousand men, possessed neither siege engines nor missile weapons, and could rely on nothing except the visual confusion it could create in the dark and the speed with which it could close on the imperial convoy. Two third parties lay on further fronts: the Turks on the northern steppe and Goguryeo in the northeast. Both absorbed the best of Sui's cavalry and supplies, leaving the belly of Hebei in the autumn of 613 short of reinforcements and short of any heavy force capable of crushing a rising quickly. The whole situation can be put in one line: the centre held the localities through system and paperwork, the insurgents tried to open a breach through the night, and what actually settled the matter was whether the commandery troops and the county officials could put it down in the dark.
people: 宋子賢是這場衝突中唯一留下姓名的起事首腦。他是隋朝唐縣人，以幻術為業。據唐代段成式《廣古今五行記》，他每夜在自己居處的樓上放出光明，能變作佛的形狀，自稱彌勒佛出世，又在堂中懸鏡，壁上盡是獸形；來禮謁的人轉動鏡子，便看見所謂來生的形象，或作蛇獸形，告以罪業，令其重新禮念，才轉成人形示之。這套手法不是戰鬥技藝，而是把民間對亂世、對彌勒救世的期待收攏成對一個人的服從。隋煬帝楊廣是這場陰謀的目標而非參與者：大業九年秋，他自遼東班師北上，巡行河北，閏九月幸博陵，十月詔改博陵為高陽郡，並召高祖時故吏量材授職，隨駕文武與宿衛都在那一帶宿衛。事發後奉命搜捕的，是郡縣派出的捕吏與兵眾；其中一名為主的將領在兵眾畏懼火坑而不敢進時說出「此地素無坑，止妖妄耳」，一句話拆掉了整個幻術的信用，此人遂下令進兵，擒斬宋子賢。事後的牽連由戶籍與地方官員系統承接，一千多戶人家因連帶受審。
peopleEn: Song Zixian is the only leader of the rising whose name has come down to us. He was a man of Tang County in Sui, living by sleight of hand. According to the Guang Gujin Wuxing Ji, compiled by the Tang writer Duan Chengshi, every night he released a light from the upper storey of the house where he lived, could take on the form of the Buddha, and declared himself Maitreya come into the world. He also hung a mirror in the hall while the walls were covered with the shapes of beasts. Visitors who came to pay respects were made to turn the mirror and so saw what were said to be images of their next life, sometimes in the shape of serpents and beasts; he told them of their sins, made them repeat their vows, and only then turned the mirror to show them human forms. The procedure was not a martial technique at all: it gathered the popular expectation of a disordered age and of a Maitreya who would save the world into obedience to one man. Sui Yangdi was the target of the plot, not a participant in it. In the autumn of the ninth year of Daye the emperor moved north from the war in Liaodong and toured Hebei; in the intercalary ninth month he visited Boling, and in the tenth month he issued an edict renaming Boling as GaoYang, summoning former officials of the founding emperor and assigning them posts according to their abilities, while the civil and military officers of the retinue and the guard were quartered in that same district. When the affair broke, the arrest party was made up of constables and soldiers sent out by the commandery and the county. One officer in command, faced with troops who would not advance because of the fire pits, said that there had never been pits on that ground and that it was all sorcery and delusion; that single sentence destroyed the credit of the whole illusion, the officer ordered the advance, and Song Zixian was taken and beheaded. The aftermath was carried by the household registers and the local officials, and more than a thousand households were drawn into the case.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬重步兵屬於公元前一世紀末至公元一世紀的地中海世界：分段鎧甲、大弧形重盾，裝備重心全在防禦面與列陣密度上；卡面自己寫得清楚——羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。但這件兵器在613年的河北完全不存在：西羅馬帝國早已滅亡數百年，重步兵的編制與裝具也不會出現在隋朝的軍籍裏。它在這場戰役裏的位置，只能當成一把對照的尺，用來衡量唐縣起事者手上真正有的東西。宋子賢這一方沒有鎧甲，也沒有成建制的重盾，能倚仗的裝備是民間可以即得之物：短刀、環首刀、削尖的木矛、繩索，以及農具改成的叉、鍬、梃，還有製作幻術用的道具——燈燭、油膏、銅鏡、帷幕與能噴煙的藥料，牆上的獸形則靠燈影與帷幕遮擋造成。旗幡與幢是這一支人馬最像軍隊的東西，因為「彌勒佛出世」需要被看見、被舉起。隋廷一方則是另一套裝備體系：橫刀與儀刀、槊、臂弓與蹶張弩、將士的冑甲與馬匹、宿衛用的長兵，以及州郡兵現徵現集時的行裝。兩相比較，卡面上的重步兵所代表的「重裝列陣」在本役完全缺席：宋子賢靠的不是裝備，而是把黑夜變成自己的戰場。
kitsEn: The Roman legionary on the card belongs to the Mediterranean world of the late first century BC and the first century AD: segmented armour and a large curved heavy shield, with the whole burden of the equipment set on the defensive face and on the density of the line. The card says so itself: what gave Rome its strength was the replacement of men and the supply line, not the weight of its armour. But this weapon simply did not exist in Hebei in 613. The Western Roman Empire had been gone for several centuries, and neither the organisation nor the kit of the heavy infantry appears anywhere in the Sui military rolls. In this campaign its only place is as a ruler for comparison, a way of measuring what the insurgents of Tang County actually held in their hands. Song Zixian's side had no armour and no shield of any kind; what it could rely on was what an ordinary household could lay hands on: short knives, ring-pommel sabres, sharpened wooden spears, cordage, and farm implements turned into forks, spades and clubs. To that must be added the apparatus of the illusion: lamps and candles, oil and grease, a bronze mirror, hangings, and the materials that could throw up smoke; the beast shapes on the wall were produced by lamp shadow and concealed hangings. Banners and streamers were the most soldierly things this band possessed, because the claim that Maitreya had come into the world had to be seen and had to be carried on poles. The Sui side worked from an entirely different system: horizontal and ceremonial sabres, the long cavalry lance, arm bows and the strong pull crossbow, armour and horses for the men, pole weapons for the guard, and the field kit of commandery soldiers levied on the spot. By comparison, the heavy infantry of the card, and the idea of a line formed in heavy equipment, is wholly absent from this campaign. Song Zixian's strength was not equipment; it was the turning of night into his own field of battle.
tactics: 起事方的戰術核心是時間與光線。他們只在夜裡活動：白日收攤，夜里在樓上放光，讓遠近的香客與好奇者聚集到能看見光的位置；堂中的鏡子與壁上的獸形則把圍觀變成儀式，來拜的人以為自己在看見來生，於是被要求「更禮念」，重複這個過程的人越聚越多。等隋煬帝的車駕停在高陽一帶，宋子賢的打算不是正面進攻宿衛與行營，而是趁夜接近乘輿，用一場短促的衝擊把皇帝本人解決掉——這種計畫不要求能打，只要求能快、能亂、能讓近衛在黑暗中分不清方向。防守端同樣是幻術：居所周圍掘出火坑，用火與煙製造阻嚇。官軍夜至，繞著居處盤旋，見到火坑而不敢進；領兵的將領判斷「此地素無坑，止妖妄耳」，下令進逼，坑中果然沒有火，幻術當場破掉，宋子賢被擒斬。整場衝突沒有雲梯、沒有撞車、沒有箭雨，靠的是一次夜襲、一次識破、一次當場格殺。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the insurgents was time and light. They operated only at night: by day the show was struck, by night the light was released from the upper storey, drawing the pilgrims and the curious from near and far to the places from which the light could be seen. The mirror in the hall and the beast shapes on the wall turned watching into a rite. Those who came to worship believed they were looking upon their next life, and were then told to repeat their vows; the more people went through that process, the larger the crowd became. When the emperor's convoy came to a halt in the GaoYang district, Song Zixian's plan was not to assault the guard and the encampment in the open, but to close on the imperial carriage by night and end it in one short rush. A plan of that kind does not require an army that can fight; it requires speed, confusion, and the ability to make the household guard lose its sense of direction in the dark. The defensive side was illusion as well: pits were dug around the dwelling, and fire and smoke were used to hold an attacker back. The official soldiers came up at night and circled the house; seeing the fire pits they did not dare to advance. The officer in command judged that there had never been pits on that ground and that it was all sorcery and delusion; he ordered the advance, and there was indeed no fire in the pits, the illusion collapsed on the spot, and Song Zixian was taken and beheaded. There were no scaling ladders, no battering rams and no arrow storm in the whole affair: there was a night approach, a moment of recognition, and a killing on the spot.
data: 大業九年即公元613年，是隋煬帝第二次征高句麗的第二年：正月車駕至涿郡，戰事延到夏天，秋天自遼東班師北上，閏九月幸博陵，十月詔改博陵郡為高陽郡；同月又記「賊帥呂明星率眾數千圍東郡，武賲郎將費青奴擊斬之」，可見當時河北與山東的警訊同時存在，起事並非孤例。距離上，唐縣在太行山東麓、曲陽與拒馬河之間，屬保定府一線，東距博陵(高陽郡治)數十里，西去瀛州高陽縣也在百餘里以內，車駕自涿郡南下的官道正穿過這一片。《廣古今五行記》記宋子賢「遠近惑信，聚數千百人」，事後「連坐者一千多家」——這兩個數字是本役僅有的量化記載，一個是聚眾規模，一個是牽連的戶數。此外本役沒有留下陣亡、俘獲、攻城與行程日期的數字，不宜補造。河北省的戰亂規模在隋末是空前的：大業七年楊玄感起兵時河北鄉兵曾大舉響應，此後李子通、竇建德、瓦崗一系人物相繼在河北與山東聚兵，唐縣這樣的民間結社，只是其中最小的一顆火星。
dataEn: The ninth year of Daye was 613 AD, the second year of Yangdi's second campaign against Goguryeo. In the first month the imperial carriage reached Zhuojun; the fighting ran through the summer, and in the autumn the army withdrew from Liaodong and moved north. In the intercalary ninth month the emperor visited Boling, and in the tenth month an edict renamed the commandery of Boling as GaoYang. In that same month the chronicle also records that the bandit chief Lü Mingxing led several thousand men to surround Dong commandery and was cut down and killed by the Wuwen Langjiang Fei Qingnu, which shows that alarms in Hebei and in Shandong existed at one and the same time and that risings were not isolated. As for distances, Tang County lies on the eastern foot of the Taihang, between Quyang and the Juma River, on the Baoding line; it is a few dozen li east of Boling, the seat of GaoYang commandery, and less than a hundred li from GaoYang county in Yingzhou, and the official road by which the carriage came south from Zhuojun ran straight through this country. The Guang Gujin Wuxing Ji records that, far and near, men were deceived and gathered, several hundreds and thousands of them, and that more than a thousand households were drawn in afterwards. These two figures are the only quantitative entries that survive for this campaign: one is the size of the following, the other the number of households implicated. No figures survive for casualties, prisoners, siege operations or the exact days of the journey, and none should be invented. The scale of disturbance in Hebei in the late Sui was without precedent: when Yang Xuangan rose in the seventh year of Daye the village levies of Hebei answered him in great numbers, and afterwards men such as Li Zitong, Dou Jiande and the figures of the Wagang group mustered their forces in Hebei and Shandong one after another. A private association like that of Tang County was only the smallest of sparks.
cause: 三條線在613年的河北疊到一起。第一是兵：隋煬帝自大業八年冬到九年春第二次征高句麗，糧秣徵發、徭役與運丁集中在河北、河南與山東；戰事失利之後，役夫與民眾並未解散，而是被原籍郡縣登記、編入屯田與州郡兵，兵與役的邊界因此模糊不清，州縣手上的武裝既不純粹也不受訓練。第二是饑：大業年間河北連遭水旱，饑民往就食於州城與都城，人數積聚在城郊荒野，成為任何能給出一句應驗話語的人的材料。第三是信仰：彌勒救世在民間流傳已久，隋文帝與隋煬帝都曾以彌勒名號聚眾為由打壓民間的末世期待，「彌勒出世」四個字本身就是一句徵召。宋子賢的機會正在這裡——他不需要軍餉與裝備，只需要每夜放一次光、變一次佛形，就能把散亂的饑民與不平者變成聽話的群眾；而目標的選擇同樣清楚：隋煬帝正在河北巡行，車駕與宿衛隨隊移動卻遠離京畿與州郡主力，若能乘夜襲其乘輿，任何守軍都來不及結陣。這是一場把宗教幻象、饑荒聚集與巡幸行程三件事疊在一起的暗殺企圖。
causeEn: Three threads came together in Hebei in 613. The first was soldiers. From the winter of the eighth year of Daye to the spring of the ninth, Yangdi was conducting his second campaign against Goguryeo, and the requisition of grain, the corvée and the transport of labour were concentrated in Hebei, Henan and Shandong. When the campaign failed, the labourers and the people were not released: they were registered by their native commanderies and counties and folded into the garrison farms and the commandery troops, so that the line between soldier and labourer became blurred, and the armed men in the hands of the prefectures were neither pure nor well trained. The second was hunger. Hebei suffered repeated floods and droughts through the Daye years, and starving people moved toward the walled towns and the capital, where they collected in huge numbers on the open ground outside the walls; they were exactly the raw material for anyone able to utter a sentence that sounded like prophecy. The third was faith. Expectation of a Maitreya who would save the world had long circulated among the people, and both Wen and Yang of Sui had suppressed the popular millenarian hopes that gathered under that name; the four words Maitreya come into the world were themselves a call to arms. Song Zixian's opportunity lay precisely there: he needed neither pay nor equipment, only a light shown every night and a Buddha's shape assumed once, to turn scattered starving and resentful people into an obedient crowd. The choice of target was equally clear. Yangdi was touring Hebei; his convoy and guard moved with him but stood far from the capital and from the main strength of the prefectures; had the carriage been rushed at night, no defending force would have had time to form up. This was an attempt at assassination that stacked a religious illusion, a famine-driven gathering and an imperial itinerary on top of one another.
impact: 就當時而言，宋子賢起義沒有造成會戰、沒有攻陷郡城、沒有割據一州，但它留下三樣東西。第一是證據：河北民間可以用最便宜的手段——燈、鏡、帷幕——製造出足以數千人群聚的幻象，而且真的能把這樣的幻象轉成刺殺皇帝的行動計畫。第二是鎮壓的樣板：事發後的處理是速決的，殺首惡、拆幻術、連坐戶籍，一千多家的牽連被記進《廣古今五行記》，成為隋廷面對「以彌勒為名的聚眾」時的既定辦法：早發現、早鎮壓、把網撒到親屬與鄰里。第三是時間表上的提醒：這件事證明在隋煬帝巡行河北、北方精騎調往遼東與塞北的年份，首都與皇帝本人都可變成攻擊目標；從613年到617年，河北與山東的起義者越來越多，李子通、竇建德、杜伏威與瓦崗的翟讓各自在別處聚兵，而隋煬帝在江都與北返之間往返，把可供防守的中樞越拉越長。至於後世，這條記載因為來自《廣古今五行記》這部偏於軼聞的書而常被略過，但它使大業末年的河北從單純的饑荒地帶，變成可以看清的動亂地帶。
impactEn: In its own time the rising of Song Zixian produced no battle, no captured commandery seat and no separatist state, but it left three things behind. The first was a demonstration. The people of Hebei could, with the cheapest of means — lamps, a mirror, hangings — produce an illusion that gathered several thousand, and they really could turn such an illusion into an operational plan to kill the emperor. The second was a pattern of suppression. The handling afterwards was summary: the chief was killed, the illusion broken, and the households swept in; the more than a thousand households implicated were written into the record of the Guang Gujin Wuxing Ji, and this became the standing method by which the Sui court faced gatherings in the name of Maitreya — find them early, crush them early, and spread the net to relatives and neighbours. The third was a warning on the calendar of the reign. It showed that in a year when Yangdi was touring Hebei and the northern cavalry was drawn off to Liaodong and the steppe, both the capital and the emperor himself could be made into a target. Between 613 and 617 the risers in Hebei and Shandong multiplied; Li Zitong, Dou Jiande, Du Fuwei and Zhai Rang of the Wagang group each mustered men elsewhere, while Yangdi shuttled between Jiangdu and the north, stretching the centre he could still defend ever thinner. For later ages, this account is often passed over because it survives in the Guang Gujin Wuxing Ji, a book given to marvels; but it turns the Hebei of the late Daye years from a mere zone of famine into a zone of visible disturbance.
result: 結果簡短而確定：事洩，官軍連夜搜捕，幻術被識破，宋子賢被擒斬，隨之連坐者一千多家，河北的這一場刺殺企圖在爆發之前就結束了，隋朝中央一時未受損，行營與乘輿照常運作，車駕沿官道繼續南行。這場戰爭的記載確實有限：正史的《隋書》帝紀與《資治通鑑》都沒有為宋子賢立一條記載，現存唯一完整的敘述來自唐代段成式的《廣古今五行記》，後來又被類書收錄，因此兵員、日期與經過都缺環節，只能確定大業九年、唐縣人、以幻術聚眾、自稱彌勒佛出世、擬襲高陽一帶乘輿、事洩被斬這幾個要點。仍然可以確定的是：隋朝在最後五年裡，河北的民間結社與宗教幻象已經能構成可實施的刺殺手段，中央只能用高壓連坐與快速鎮壓來處理，而答案本身又加深了河北的怨懼；隨着大業十三年之後更大規模的起義席捲全國，隋煬帝於618年在江都遇害，隋朝隨即覆亡。
resultEn: The outcome is short and certain. The affair was discovered, the official troops searched the place by night, the illusion was seen through, Song Zixian was taken and beheaded, and more than a thousand households were drawn in with him. The attempt on Hebei was therefore over before it had begun to burn, the central government of Sui was not harmed at that moment, the encampment and the imperial carriage went on functioning as before, and the carriage continued south along the official road. The record of this campaign is indeed thin: neither the imperial annals of the Suishu nor the Zizhi Tongjian devotes a line to Song Zixian, and the only surviving full account comes from the Guang Gujin Wuxing Ji of the Tang writer Duan Chengshi, later taken up by encyclopedic collections, so that the numbers, the dates and the stages of the business all have gaps. What can be settled is the year, the ninth of Daye, the man from Tang County, the gathering by sleight of hand, the claim to be Maitreya come into the world, the intention of falling on the carriage in the GaoYang district, and the killing after the affair was betrayed. What can also be settled is that in the last five years of Sui, private associations and religious illusions in Hebei had become capable of mounting an assassination that was actually executable, and that the centre could answer only with severe collective liability and very fast suppression — an answer that deepened the resentment of Hebei. And when, after the thirteenth year of Daye, far larger risings swept the country, Yangdi was killed at Jiangdu in 618 and the Sui dynasty went down with him.
